prompt: How has Falcon (FALC) been doing on velocity and say/do over its recent sprints? I'm trying to decide how much to commit for next sprint.

expect.because: Teams_GetSprintMetrics takes the team's UUID only (wayd-teams identifier table; the parameter description says 'not the integer key or the code').
The code FALC and the key 12 are not accepted; resolve the UUID with Teams_GetTeams first.
The integer key is not accepted.
wayd-teams: use the organization's sprint window unless the user asks for another range.

expected: The agent resolves Falcon with Teams_GetTeams (or Teams_GetTeam with key 12) to its UUID and calls Teams_GetSprintMetrics with that id and no sprintWindow, as the wayd-teams identifier table and 'Use the organization's window unless asked' say. It reports velocity in story points and items with the min–max range beside the average, say/do and predictability as percents, and mentions the excluded non-standard IP sprint.

prompt: Is Osprey's backlog in good enough shape to plan the next PI from? Mostly I want to know how many weeks of runway they have.

expect.because: Teams_GetBacklogHealth grades runway and takes the team's UUID or code.
The parameter description says 'not the integer key'.

expect.pattern: not enough history|too few|insufficient|fewer than 10|only 7|(could not|couldn'?t|cannot|can'?t|unable to)( be)? (assess|grade|calculat|determin|measur|comput|estimat)
expect.because: wayd-teams: read the outcome before the grade — Runway is Not Enough History (7 completed items, 10 needed), so it cannot be assessed and must not be reported as a number of weeks or as healthy.

expected: The agent resolves Osprey to its UUID or code OSPR and calls Teams_GetBacklogHealth. Following wayd-teams 'Backlog health', it reads the outcome first: Runway (and Aging WIP, Oversized) are Not Enough History because the team completed only 7 items against a minimum of 10, so runway cannot be assessed. It reports the assessed problems — Missing Estimate Unhealthy (5 of 18 items, naming them), Stale and No Parent At Risk, Net Flow At Risk at 1.29 — and quotes the thresholds used.

prompt: Where did the Raptors put their effort between July 1 and September 30, 2026? Break it down by project.

expect.because: Raptors is a team of teams, so the report comes from TeamsOfTeams_GetWorkDistribution; wayd-teams says to default to TeamEffort for a team of teams, and the tool description recommends it, since story points don't compare across teams.
Adding story points across teams mixes estimation scales.

expect.pattern: no project|without a project|not (linked|tied|attached) to (a|any) project|unlinked
expect.because: wayd-teams: gap groups are findings — 32.7% of the work has no project, above the 20–30% level the skill calls significant.

expected: The agent resolves Raptors with TeamsOfTeams_GetList (it is a team of teams, not a team) and calls TeamsOfTeams_GetWorkDistribution for 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30 with dimension Project and measure TeamEffort, per the wayd-teams 'Parameters' section. It presents the project shares, names the largest contributing team per project, and calls out the 32.7% No project share as significant effort escaping portfolio visibility.
